# SCAN-AND-PAY

> Every page of the SCAN-AND-PAY module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

In this user can select the multiple procedures.

If the notification is not get from HIP then this API will help to check the status on HIU side.
